newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to lower margins on milk futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to lower margins on milk futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Wednesday it will lower margins on the April 1997 and May 1997 milk contracts by $50 to $250, effective March 27.
The margin on all other milk contracts will also be decreased by $50 to $250, the exchange said in a statement.

As a result, the inter-commodity straddle rate for milk/cheddar cheese will be decreased by $20, to $160. For milk/nonfat dry milk the straddle rate will be lowered by $90, to $630, and for milk/nonfat dry milk/butter the straddle rate will decline by $137.50, to $1,127.50, the CSCE said.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
